evidence: Row-35 source/finite-observation requirement passes; this is not a full configured grading clearance. The actual frozen workbook Quality Checks!D36 requires defining behavior plus reload/re-auth durability and server backing; its Internal Quality Checks!D36 agrees. Frozen quality-checks.md:145-147 makes no same-origin requirement. Public defining behavior is saved, atomic, affordable coordinated changes with stale-preview refusal and immutable retry receipts (task/instruction.md:1-9; environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:422-481). Functional judge.toml hro_change_net_budget at 933-939 requires both a fully committed cross-requisition cycle and same-requisition offset to commit and checks final balances/movements; hro_change_lineage at 951-957 checks each persisted successor. hro_change_stale_leaf/aba/overlap require unchanged all-member financial history around refused commits (1041-1056,1086-1092). A dead operation cannot earn these successful outcomes. Durability is explicit and graded: hro_gate_shared requires a new UI-created requisition and offer to reappear with their values in an independent empty signed-in context (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-25); functional prompt.md:9,15 excludes a same-context reload or HTTP200 as independent-storage evidence. hro_change_preview_durable at 1014-1020 retrieves saved identity/intent/preview in a fresh independent context; hro_change_receipt at 1104-1110 retrieves the transaction receipt after fresh sign-in. hro_restart at 924-930 and hro_change_retry_restart at 1149-1155 require one real process restart and original-result retry with no duplicate effects. Functional prompt.md:53 puts restart after B protocols and preserves ordinary fresh writes even if complex branches fail. The template persistence/restart contract is preserved, with restart MCP wired at functional judge.toml:14-18 and same DB_PATH used by test.sh:97-193. Verified local raw observations support feasibility without being judge scores: batch-domain.cjs:35-68 verifies netted commits and their financial/lineage changes; :112-119 compares original receipt, financial records and saved change sets after later revision/rescission and an actual process stop/start over the same DB. Its results.json records all 15 finite groups passing. batch-ui.cjs:29-54 exercises UI prepare/commit, lost-response retry and a separate Auditor context; its fixture setup is API-based and its independent-context assertion is narrower than every criterion, so it is supporting evidence only. install-lifecycle.py:39-47 invokes the real shared restart MCP, observes old PID termination and a changed PID, reauthenticates and compares the saved record; results.json reports PID 21 to 97. local/mcp/results.json records actual browser_run_code_unsafe newContext/login/readback on pinned MCP tooling. Golden source uses SQLite DB_PATH and seed-once (solution/app/src/db.js:13,22-29,122-124), saved preview/receipt JSON and immediate commit transaction (src/change-sets.js:8-20,77-98,127-140). Hash audit evidence/35/verified-evidence.json verified all 317 then-current raw-index entries with zero mismatches and 44 cited source bindings against frozen bytes with zero mismatches; the workbook SHA256 is 6d44970b2ff67fefad1e2327e743fc226fcd4c50ff55baf899f41069a9b3fd7f. The selected artifact hashes are recorded there. Risk remains true because the index explicitly lacks full configured judge execution/workload and empirical app reward discrimination/ranking, Oracle/target and hosted scores. No such result is inferred from these scripts or source checks. No row-35 source defect was confirmed.
counterexample: Broken-app checks: a client-only localStorage save fails the required independent empty-context readback; a server-memory-only desk fails the real restart readback; a desk posting members sequentially cannot complete the fully funded exchange; a receipt cache that is lost/revalidated after later changes cannot satisfy original-result retry. These are analytic protocol checks, not invented judge runs. Existing hash-verified local/batch-witnesses.cjs:9-22 and results.json actually distinguish sequential_budget (409 instead of 200), balance_only_version (200 instead of required 409 after ABA), and no_cached_receipt (409 instead of original 200). Conforming alternative: omitting optional operational seed history while retaining users/constants and new durable writes is publicly valid; the empty_operational_seed variant completes all 15 scripted groups. Generated IDs, different routes/field names/layouts and CDN browser assets remain permitted by functional prompt.md:13 and app_context.md:25-27; no source engine or same-origin proof is imposed by these durability criteria.
